The time dependence is only through the t²√P term. A degree-5 polynomial in √P plus that term gives 1.6e-10, so the P³ and P^3.5 terms are needed. I did not check whether a more compact closed form exists. The P^3.5 coefficient is tiny, so dropping it may be worth testing.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    s = np.sqrt(P)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*s + params[2]*P + params[3]*P**1.5 + params[4]*P**2
            + params[5]*P**2.5 + params[6]*P**3 + params[7]*P**3.5 + params[8]*t**2*s)
